{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if the conversion worked
print("Revenue conversion check:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].head())

# Now, filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & 
                       (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check the filtered data
print("\nFiltered data (first 5 rows):")
print(filtered_df.head())

print("\nNumber of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH:")
print(len(filtered_df))

# Calculate conversion rate
conversion_rate = filtered_df['converted'].mean()

print("\nConversion rate:")
print(conversion_rate)"}
